description: RC3.2: the radiance cache's world cache, populated and resolved through the technique at 1280x720: a sunlit corner (floor and wall, black sky) converges in its cells and probe rays to albedo/pi x E within 2%; UpdateTiles caps the sample count at 16 and its mips are 2x2 sums; ResolveCells reads a coarser mip while a cell has fewer than 16 samples (point light, fresh cache); emissive hits and rays shorter than their cell skip the cache; two coloured suns average to their sum within 2% (the light weight). Correctness only.
